title: Second Conditional: Unreal Situations — Quiz 79

## Second Conditional: Unreal Situations

Choose past simple forms for imaginary conditions.

### Lesson focus

1. If I ___ enough money, I would buy a Mercedes Benz. (had / had had)
2. I could get a job easily if I ___ a degree. (had / would have)
3. What would you do if you ___ the last bus? (missed / had missed)

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
